name: Tightening
description: Rules at an even weight but a closing pitch, so the field densifies downward.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @calc(6 - 3 * @y / @Y)%, transparent @calc(6 - 3 * @y / @Y)% @calc(34 - 26 * @y / @Y)%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @calc(6 - 3 * @y / @Y)%, transparent @calc(6 - 3 * @y / @Y)% @calc(34 - 26 * @y / @Y)%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
